battery.notes: Notebookcheck measured ~17h Wi-Fi browsing on the reviewed Panther Lake OmniBook X 14 config.

price.notes: Best Buy CA SKU 20174277 reg $1,990, frequently on sale ~$1,098 (2026-11-24 API). NBC's '$1,900' US complaint matches CA regular pricing.

offers.name: HP OmniBook X 14" 2K IPS Display Copilot Laptop Intel Core Ultra 5 325 16GB 512GB Windows 11 Home Atmospheric blue

reviews.quote: This Panther Lake productivity powerhouse lasts 17 hours, but HP wants $1,900

praises: 17-hour battery in Notebookcheck's Wi-Fi test — best runtime in the Canadian 14-inch premium class
2K (2240x1400) panel is a real step up from the 1200p budget tier
Panther Lake Ultra 5 is quick and cool for office/productivity work
Frequent Best Buy discounts to ~$1,100 make it the value king of premium 14-inchers
Good port mix for a thin machine: 2x TB4 + USB-A + HDMI
complaints: $1,990 regular price is steep for a 60Hz 300-nit IPS panel (NBC's exact complaint)
Modest 2-speaker audio vs OmniBook Ultra quad-speaker
iGPU only — no creative-class graphics headroom
Marketplace seller stock at Best Buy, not direct HP

design_philosophy: HP's mainstream-premium Panther Lake clamshell: understated aluminium everyday machine optimised for battery life and productivity rather than screen spectacle — the sensible sibling to the OLED OmniBook Ultra.
rating_notes: Ratings anchored on Notebookcheck's reviewed Panther Lake OmniBook X 14 (17h battery headline verified; full score page blocked). This Ultra 5 tier inferred vs reviewed higher tier: -0.5 productivity, panel deltas applied (2K IPS 60Hz = 7.0).
